title: Desktop first-run: the interface language follows the computer's, a saved pick wins, an unoffered one falls back to English with a line
steps: S1: run the desktop locale bootstrap/bridge tests and the tracy-onboard language-note tests (node:test).
S2: the end-to-end form of this case is ST-7 in tests/acceptance/desktop-onboard-v2 (app from source with -AppleLanguages de-AT / ja-JP and a saved fr pick).
expect: __DSH_LOCALE__ answers the OS languages; with no pick preference is null, with the tracy_lang cookie the pick is handed back so the device never overrides it.
A device language Tracy offers (de-AT) gives no line; an unoffered one (ja-JP) names it in its own language and the language used instead; a saved pick gives no line.

tests: no pick: the OS languages, preference null
a pick stands: it is handed back as the preference
the product page gets the OS languages, most preferred first
the device language is offered (vi-VN, de-AT, zh-Hans-CN): no line
not offered (ja-JP): the line names it in its own language
a saved pick: no line, whatever the device says

fence: the saved pick (tracy_lang) is never replaced by the OS language through the native bootstrap
